plugins.name: wildcat-radio
plugins.description: A Radio tab that turns an RTL-SDR Blog V4 into one instrument: a live waterfall with a tuning strip, a receiver-style tuner with recording, a band map, a planes radar from ADS-B, APRS, decoded NOAA weather alerts, the gadgets rtl_433 hears nearby, a scanner and a Web SDR. Six tools and a radio-guide skill let Claude read the radio, scan a band, listen and switch the safe jobs. Receive only. /sdr to open it.
